summary: Hydro One Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that its subsidiary, Hydro One Networks Inc., has submitted two leave-to-construct applications to the Ontario Energy Board for two transmission line projects: the Northeast Power Line ($1.8B, completion 2029) and the Longwood to Lakeshore Transmission Line ($1.2B, completion 2030). No terms such as stake, price, or premium are involved. The filing does not relate to any special situation (M&A, activist, restructuring, etc.). This is a routine reporting of a regulatory application for infrastructure projects.
